bull.b: Converting over 40 design wins into mass production creates durable revenue visibility and lowers customer adoption risk. Sustained product-led growth (strong sequential product sales) supports scale economies, better factory utilization, and steadier OEM relationships over the next 2–3 years as deployments ramp.

bull.t: Cleaner balance sheet after debt redemption
bull.b: Eliminating convertible debt materially reduces refinancing and dilution risk and simplifies capital structure, improving financial flexibility. bull.t: Large multi-year product pipeline & RF expansion
bull.b: A sizeable pipeline with over half already in production signals multi-year addressable revenue and reduced near-term pipeline risk. bear.t: Compressed gross margins and sustained operating losses
bear.b: A marked margin decline driven by a heavier low‑margin product mix plus persistent OpEx means the business needs substantial revenue scale to absorb fixed costs. bear.b: Material upside in guidance depends on closing licensing/service agreements whose timing is uncertain, creating revenue lumpiness.
